name: dnsdist Self-Hosted DNS Load Balancer
free_limit: GPLv2 self-hosted DNS-aware traffic load balancing, backend health checks, abuse/DoS filtering and Prometheus/HTTP metrics; no vendor-side DNS request quota.
watch_out: dnsdist is a DNS proxy/load balancer, not a hosted authoritative DNS service or standalone resolver; requires configured upstream DNS backends, infrastructure and secure operations. GPL obligations apply; commercial support is separate.
